goal: Maximize the digester's mean true methane outflow (m3/d) over 100 days (400 decisions) without ever leaving its operating limits: pH at least 6.5 and total VFA at most 1.0 kgCOD/m3 at every decision. An episode that leaves the limits even once scores 0 (it still ends normally, truncated after decision 400).
description: microbesGYM's A1 anaerobic digester (study control_a1_loading, aligned experiment, reference backend), wrapped unchanged. One decision every 6 hours, 400 decisions (100 days). An episode ends early only through A1's own termination (the digester soured); otherwise it is truncated after decision 400 (A1 also truncates an episode if its solver fails). ACTION: a list with one float, the controlled pump's feed command in m3/d, from 0 to 255. The pump starts every episode at 85 m3/d and moves at most 34 m3/d towards the command at each decision. The plant's own influent arrives on a fixed schedule that is the same in every episode; its composition is drawn at random per episode and is never observed. REWARD: the true methane outflow (m3/d) after each step. OBSERVABLES (readings carry A1's measurement noise; no true state and no influent composition are observed): day = decision number x 0.25 (0 at the reset). ch4_flow, co2_flow = gas meter, m3/d, a new reading at every decision. ch4_pressure = methane partial pressure, bar, at every decision. vfa_s_va, vfa_s_bu, vfa_s_pro, vfa_s_ac = valerate, butyrate, propionate and acetate assays, kgCOD/m3. inorganic_carbon = assay, mM. The five assays arrive together every fourth decision (first at decision 4), each sampled four decisions before it arrives, so the newest assay describes the digester as it was 4 to 7 decisions earlier; they read 0.0 before the first arrives. assay_age = int, decisions since the newest assays arrived (0 on arrival, then 1 to 3), -1 before the first. The sum of the four VFA assays approximates (with noise) total VFA, the limited quantity; pH is not observed. EPISODE RECORD (None at every step, filled in only in the observation that ends the episode, which no program acts on): mean_ch4_flow = mean true methane outflow over the decisions, m3/d; min_ph = lowest true pH; max_total_vfa = highest true total VFA, kgCOD/m3; first_out = number (from 1) of the first decision outside the limits, or None; score = A1's score, mean_ch4_flow if first_out is None, else 0. SEEDS: 1001-1008 and 6001-6020 use A1's training draws, every other seed its validation draws, so the evaluation seeds 5001-5010 are validation draws that the baseline seeds do not cover; every episode runs in stochastic mode. A1's published results (its baseline ladder, tuned controllers, learned agents and reports) are not targets. Do not use them for the goal or any milestone. Set each new milestone above what this loop's own best program reaches, and keep raising it: the goal is the most methane within the limits, not beating a reference.

milestones.name: within_limits
milestones.description: The episode runs all 400 decisions and never leaves the limits (first_out is None). Baseline evidence (seeds 6001/6002/6003, training draws): min_ph never fell below 7.32 in any condition, so total VFA is the binding limit. hold_0, hold_64 and hold_128 stayed within the limits on all three seeds; hold_128 is the highest tested constant feed that was safe on all three (mean methane 1778.9 to 2436.5 m3/d, max total VFA at most 0.5796, on seed 6002). hold_192 left the VFA limit on seed 6002 at decision 12 (max total VFA 1.29), hold_255 on seeds 6002 and 6003 at decisions 8 and 12, and step_64_192 on seed 6002 at decision 213, 13 decisions after its step, so delaying an increase does not by itself establish safety. The evaluation seeds use validation draws, which the baselines did not cover.

subgoals.name: safe_start
subgoals.description: Stay within the VFA limit through the first assays. A feed of 192 or 255 m3/d left the limit by decision 8 to 12, while the assays that arrive at decisions 4, 8 and 12 describe the digester at decisions 0, 4 and 8, so an aggressive start gets no warning in time.

strategies.name: hold_128_start
strategies.description: Command 128 m3/d from decision 0 (the pump reaches it by decision 2 from 85) and do not exceed it before at least the assays of decisions 8 and 12 have arrived. Evidence: hold_128 stayed within the limits on all three baseline seeds with max total VFA at most 0.58.

strategies.name: conservative_fallback
strategies.description: If the first assays are already high (sum of the four VFA assays above about 0.5 kgCOD/m3 at 128 m3/d), drop towards 64 m3/d; hold_64 kept max total VFA at most 0.31 on all three seeds.

subgoals.name: keep_vfa_margin
subgoals.description: For the rest of the episode keep the assayed total VFA (sum of vfa_s_va, vfa_s_bu, vfa_s_pro, vfa_s_ac, dominated by acetate) well below 1.0, allowing for the 4 to 7 decision lag and for assay noise.

strategies.name: assay_guard
strategies.description: On each assay arrival (assay_age == 0) compute the VFA sum; above about 0.65 kgCOD/m3 cut the command by about 32 m3/d, above about 0.8 cut to 96 m3/d or less, otherwise keep the current feed. These thresholds are starting values to tune: safe baseline episodes peaked at 0.58 (hold_128, seed 6002), 0.61 (hold_255, seed 6001) and 0.73 (hold_192, seed 6003), and in step_64_192 on seed 6002 total VFA rose from about 0.28 to above 1.0 within 13 decisions of the step.

strategies.name: hold_128_throughout
strategies.description: Hold 128 m3/d for the whole episode as a reference safe program; it met this milestone on all three baseline seeds but is untested on the validation draws of the evaluation seeds, so combine it with assay_guard.

milestones.name: within_limits_2000
milestones.description: within_limits, and mean_ch4_flow is at least 2000 m3/d. Baseline evidence: no constant feed reached this on all three seeds. hold_128 gave 1778.9 / 2436.5 / 2106.2 m3/d on seeds 6001 / 6002 / 6003 (6001 falls short); hold_192 gave 2278.3 on 6001 and 2676.1 on 6003 but left the limit on 6002 at decision 12; hold_255 was safe only on 6001 (2751.1, max total VFA 0.61). The safe feed therefore depends on the episode's unobserved influent composition, and a program must adapt its feed per episode: higher than 128 on weak-influent episodes like 6001, at most about 128 on strong ones like 6002.

subgoals.name: identify_influent_strength
subgoals.description: Infer early in the episode whether the influent is strong (overload risk) or weak (room to raise the feed), from readings taken at a known safe feed.

strategies.name: acetate_at_128
strategies.description: Hold 128 m3/d through decision 12 and read vfa_s_ac (or the VFA sum) from the assays of decisions 8 and 12. Under hold_128 the acetate assay over days 0 to 25 averaged about 0.17 / 0.42 / 0.29 kgCOD/m3 on seeds 6001 / 6002 / 6003 (maxima 0.20 / 0.53 / 0.35), ranking the seeds in the same order as their overload risk at 192 m3/d (max total VFA 0.39 / 1.29 / 0.73). Use a low reading as permission to raise the feed and a high one (around 0.4 or more) as a reason to stay at or below 128.

strategies.name: gas_yield_hypothesis
strategies.description: HYPOTHESIS, requires validation on debug seeds before relying on it: methane flow per m3/d of feed signals influent strength earlier than the assays. Under hold_128, ch4_flow over days 0 to 25 averaged about 1691 / 2271 / 1974 m3/d on seeds 6001 / 6002 / 6003, the same ranking as the overload risk, whereas the ch4_flow at the reset (1649 / 1680 / 1617) barely separates them. Likewise ch4_pressure ran slightly higher on the overloaded runs (hold_192 mean about 0.67 to 0.68 bar on 6002 against 0.65 on 6001), but the ranges overlap within the noise. Treat both gas signals only as candidate early warnings until a program shows they predict the assays on seeds it has not been tuned on.

subgoals.name: raise_feed_with_margin
subgoals.description: On episodes judged weak, raise the feed above 128 m3/d early enough for the 400-decision mean to reach 2000 (on seed 6001 a constant 192 gave 2278, 128 only 1779), while each increase is confirmed by assays before the next.

strategies.name: slow_assay_checked_ramp
strategies.description: After decision 12, raise the command by at most 16 m3/d, no more often than every 8 decisions (two assay rounds, so the effect of an increase is visible before the next), and only while the latest VFA sum is below about 0.45 kgCOD/m3; stop raising between about 0.45 and 0.65 and cut by about 32 m3/d above 0.65. The big step of step_64_192 (64 to 192, completed by the pump within 4 decisions) left the limit on seed 6002 13 decisions after the step, so increments must be small relative to the assay lag.

strategies.name: vfa_setpoint_controller
strategies.description: An integral or PI controller acting at assay arrivals that moves the feed to keep the VFA sum near a setpoint of about 0.5 kgCOD/m3, with the feed capped at 128 m3/d before decision 12, a maximum change of 16 m3/d per assay round upwards and faster cuts downwards, and anti-windup at the pump bounds. Tune the setpoint downwards if any debug or baseline episode exceeds 0.8.
